movie.title: Toby
movie.summary: An estranged man deemed to be a beast vows to break free from the evil world and transform himself for his foster daughter.

movie.title: 12th Fail
movie.tagline: #RESTART
movie.summary: Based on the true story of IPS officer Manoj Kumar Sharma, 12th Fail sheds limelight on fearlessly embracing the idea of restarting the academic journey despite the setbacks and challenges and reclaiming one's destiny at a place where millions of students attempt the world's toughest competitive exam: UPSC.

movie.title: The Equalizer 3
movie.tagline: Justice knows no borders
movie.summary: Robert McCall finds himself at home in Southern Italy but he discovers his friends are under the control of local crime bosses. As events turn deadly, McCall knows what he has to do: become his friends' protector by taking on the mafia.

movie.title: The Equalizer 2
movie.tagline: There is no equal.
movie.summary: Robert McCall, who serves an unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed, embarks on a relentless, globe-trotting quest for vengeance when his former partner is murdered.

movie.title: The Day of the Jackal
movie.tagline: Nameless, faceless... relentlessly moving towards the date with death that would rock the world.
movie.summary: An international assassin known as ‘The Jackal’ is employed by disgruntled French generals to kill President Charles de Gaulle, with a dedicated gendarme on the assassin’s trail.

movie.title: Miami Vice
movie.tagline: No Law. No Rules. No Order.
movie.summary: A case involving drug lords and murder in South Florida takes a personal turn for undercover detectives Sonny Crockett and Ricardo Tubbs. Unorthodox Crockett gets involved romantically with the Chinese-Cuban wife of a trafficker of arms and drugs, while Tubbs deals with an assault on those he loves.

movie.title: To Be or Not to Be
movie.tagline: The Picture Everyone Wants to See
movie.summary: During the Nazi occupation of Poland, an acting troupe becomes embroiled in a Polish soldier's efforts to track down a German spy.

movie.title: The Man Who Feels No Pain
movie.summary: Leveraging his ability to withstand pain, a young man trains to follow in the footsteps of his martial arts hero.

movie.title: La La Land
movie.tagline: Here's to the fools who dream.
movie.summary: Mia, an aspiring actress, serves lattes to movie stars in between auditions and Sebastian, a jazz musician, scrapes by playing cocktail party gigs in dingy bars, but as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart.

movie.title: Reptile
movie.tagline: Shed the lies.
movie.summary: Following the brutal murder of a young real estate agent, a hardened detective attempts to uncover the truth in a case where nothing is as it seems, and by doing so dismantles the illusions in his own life.

movie.title: The Archies
movie.summary: Set in 1960s India, Archie and the gang navigate romance, friendship and the future of Riverdale as developers threaten to destroy a beloved park.

movie.title: Chithha
movie.summary: Easwaran, a young government employee gets the shock of his life when his niece Sundari goes missing. After initially wrongly accused of kidnapping her, he eventually comes to know that a child abuser has kidnapped her and he makes it his mission to rescue Sundari.

movie.title: Animal
movie.tagline: A father-son bond carved in blood.
movie.summary: The hardened son of a powerful industrialist returns home after years abroad and vows to take bloody revenge on those threatening his father's life.

movie.title: The Killer
movie.tagline: Execution is everything.
movie.summary: After a fateful miss, an assassin battles his employers, and himself, on an international manhunt he insists isn't personal.

movie.title: Jaane Jaan
movie.tagline: Love blurs the line between innocence and guilt
movie.summary: When a single mother her teenage daughter becomes ensnared in a deadly crime,  find an unexpected ally in their neighbor, a simple, doting but genius teacher math teacher comes to aid, while a tenacious cop digs into the case.

movie.title: The Man Who Would Be King
Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning Part One
The Wonderful Story of Henry Sugar
Roadrunner: A Film About Anthony Bourdain
How to Blow Up a Pipeline
The Friends of Eddie Coyle
movie.tagline: It’s a grubby, violent, dangerous world. But it’s the only world they know. And they’re the only friends Eddie has.
movie.summary: An aging hood is about to go back to prison. Hoping to escape his fate, he supplies information on stolen guns to the feds, while simultaneously supplying arms to his bank robbing chums.

movie.title: Inception
movie.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
movie.summary: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.

movie.title: Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny
Mathu Vadalara
movie.summary: Babu is a delivery boy living with his friends Yesu and Abhi. Due to his meagre salary, he decides to quit, but then Yesu gives him an idea. The idea, however, soon spirals out of control and Babu finds himself deep in trouble. Will he survive the circumstances of his own actions?

movie.title: Balagam
movie.summary: A boisterous, bawdy, meddling village patriarch Komurayya’s death just before the engagement changes the course of  his grandson Saayilu's life and the other family members, rattling some skeletons in the closet, exposing the rifts present within the family, causing bigger sociological calamities in the small village.

movie.title: Ocean's Twelve
movie.tagline: Twelve is the new eleven.
movie.summary: Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history and splitting the $160 million take, each of the infamous Ocean's crew have tried to go straight, lay low and live a legit life... but that's proven to be a challenge. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Danny Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Rome, Paris, and Amsterdam – but a Europol agent is hot on their heels.

movie.title: Ocean's Eleven
movie.tagline: Just Danny Ocean and his 11 pals.
movie.summary: Danny Ocean and his gang attempt to rob the five biggest casinos in Las Vegas in one night.

movie.title: Peeping Tom
movie.tagline: What made this the most diabolical murder weapon ever used?
movie.summary: Loner Mark Lewis works at a film studio during the day and, at night, takes racy photographs of women. Also he's making a documentary on fear, which involves recording the reactions of victims as he murders them. He befriends Helen, the daughter of the family living in the apartment below his, and he tells her vaguely about the movie he is making.

movie.title: Pardes
movie.tagline: American dreams, Indian soul.
movie.summary: Kishorilal wants an Indian bride for his westernised son. He gets him engaged to Ganga, his friend's daughter, and brings her to USA. But she shares a deeper bond with Arjun, Kishorilal's foster son.

movie.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
movie.tagline: Oh. My. Gods.
movie.summary: Billy Batson and his foster siblings, who transform into superheroes by saying "Shazam!", are forced to get back into action and fight the Daughters of Atlas, who they must stop from using a weapon that could destroy the world.

movie.title: Umberto D.
movie.summary: When elderly pensioner Umberto Domenico Ferrari returns to his boarding house from a protest calling for a hike in old-age pensions, his landlady demands her 15,000-lire rent by the end of the month or he and his small dog will be turned out onto the street. Unable to get the money in time, Umberto fakes illness to get sent to a hospital, giving his beloved dog to the landlady's pregnant and abandoned maid for temporary safekeeping.

movie.title: The Menu
movie.tagline: Painstakingly prepared. Brilliantly executed.
movie.summary: A young couple travels to a remote island to eat at an exclusive restaurant where the chef has prepared a lavish menu, with some shocking surprises.

movie.title: Rangamarthanda
movie.summary: After retirement, a Shakespearean theater actor, divides his property amongst his two children. However, their ungratefulness leaves him and his wife homeless during their old age.

movie.title: Green Chair
movie.tagline: The Crime Was Their Passion.
movie.summary: When she falls in love with a handsome minor, a South Korean housewife finds herself at the center of a sexual scandal and hounded by hungry tabloid journalists. She vows to cut him out of her life but then he reaches the age of legal consent.

movie.title: Barbarian
movie.tagline: Some stay for a night. Some stay for a week. Some never leave.
movie.summary: In town for a job interview, a young woman arrives at her Airbnb late at night only to find that it has been mistakenly double-booked and a strange man is already staying there. Against her better judgement, she decides to stay the night anyway.

movie.title: Ee Nagaraniki Emaindi?
movie.summary: Four friends, with a bittersweet history, get drunk and embark on a journey to Goa. On the trip, they lose an expensive ring which threatens to derail one of their engagement. They end up confronting one another and their own fears, as they enroll in a short film making competition in Goa to try and win the prize money for the ring.

movie.title: DJ Tillu
movie.tagline: Atluntadhi Manathoni
movie.summary: When a local DJ and his affair with a young woman put him square in the middle of a crime, he must do his best to get out of the predicament he’s in.

movie.title: Another Round
movie.tagline: What is youth? A dream. What is love? The content of the dream.
movie.summary: Four stagnant high school teachers decide to test out a theory that maintaining a constant level of intoxication will improve their overall lives.

movie.title: Gaslight
movie.tagline: One murder, many suspects; Deadly twists
movie.summary: Meesha, a young paraplegic woman confined to a wheelchair, returns to her family’s royal estate after 15 years at the behest of her estranged father, only to learn that he’s mysteriously missing and probably dead.

movie.title: Hunger
movie.tagline: There is a hunger that can never be fulfilled.
movie.summary: A talented young street-food cook pushes herself to the limit after accepting an invitation to train under an infamous and ruthless chef.

movie.title: Air
movie.tagline: Some icons are meant to fly.
movie.summary: Discover the game-changing partnership between a then undiscovered Michael Jordan and Nike's fledgling basketball division which revolutionized the world of sports and culture with the Air Jordan brand.

movie.title: Dasara
movie.summary: In 1990s, Set in small village Veerlapally, Dharani, Vennela, and Suri are childhood friends. Dharani loves Vennela, but she has Suri in her mind. Knowing Suri’s interest in Vennela, Dharani sacrifices his love and helps get them married. But Local politics between Rajanna, Shivanna and the latter's son Chinna Nambi threaten to disrupt their lives.

movie.title: Viduthalai: Part I
movie.summary: Kumaresan, a police constable, gets recruited for an operation implanted to capture Perumal Vaathiyar, who leads a separatist group dedicated to fighting against the authorities for committing atrocities against innocent village women in the name of police interrogations.

movie.title: The Second Wife
movie.summary: In the early 1960's, a Sicilian single mother marries an older, crass widowed truck driver. When he is arrested trying to smuggle an antique, she ends up falling in love with her handsome stepson.

movie.title: Y Tu Mamá También
movie.tagline: Life has its ways of teaching.
movie.summary: In Mexico, two teenage boys and an attractive older woman embark on a road trip and learn a thing or two about life, friendship, sex, and each other.

movie.title: The Passenger
movie.tagline: I used to be somebody else...but I traded him in.
movie.summary: David Locke is a world-weary American journalist who has been sent to cover a conflict in northern Africa, but he makes little progress with the story. When he discovers the body of a stranger who looks similar to him, Locke assumes the dead man's identity. However, he soon finds out that the man was an arms dealer, leading Locke into dangerous situations. Aided by a beautiful woman, Locke attempts to avoid both the police and criminals out to get him.

movie.title: Pakka Commercial
movie.summary: Son of retired judge Suryanarayana, Lucky is a talented lawyer who will argue for anyone with money. But is he really as ‘pakka commercial’ as he seems?

movie.title: Velaiyilla Pattathari
movie.summary: Raghuvaran, who is unemployed for years, gets his dream job but a powerful rival is keen to put him down. Can he take on his adversary?

movie.title: Pathaan
movie.tagline: There is a storm coming. Fasten your seatbelt.
movie.summary: A soldier caught by enemies and presumed dead comes back to complete his mission, accompanied by old companions and foes.

movie.title: Nope
movie.tagline: What’s a bad miracle?
movie.summary: Residents in a lonely gulch of inland California bear witness to an uncanny, chilling discovery.

movie.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
movie.tagline: No way back, one way out.
movie.summary: With the price on his head ever increasing, John Wick uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.

movie.title: The Servant
movie.tagline: A Terrifyingly Beautiful Motion Picture!
movie.summary: An indolent aristocrat gets more than he bargained for when he hires a competent but silently devious manservant.

movie.title: Blow-Up
movie.tagline: Sometimes, reality is the strangest fantasy of all.
movie.summary: A successful mod photographer in London whose world is bounded by fashion, pop music, marijuana, and easy sex, feels his life is boring and despairing. But in the course of a single day he unknowingly captures a death on film.

movie.title: The Leopard
movie.tagline: Luchino Visconti's enduring romantic adventure
movie.summary: As Garibaldi's troops begin the unification of Italy in the 1860s, an aristocratic Sicilian family grudgingly adapts to the sweeping social changes undermining their way of life.

movie.title: La Notte
movie.tagline: A new genre of motion picture... to make you think and feel.
movie.summary: A day in the life of an unfaithful married couple and their steadily deteriorating relationship in Milan.

movie.title: Eros
movie.tagline: Three visionary directors. One erotic journey.
movie.summary: A three-part anthology about love and sexuality: a menage-a-trois between a couple and a young woman on the coast of Tuscany; an advertising executive under enormous pressure at work, who, during visits to his psychiatrist, is pulled to delve into the possible reasons why his stress seems to manifest itself in a recurring erotic dream; a story of unrequited love about a beautiful, 1960s high-end call girl in an impossible affair with her young tailor.

movie.title: L'Eclisse
movie.tagline: The ache and ecstasy of love…
movie.summary: Vittoria is a beautiful literary translator living in Rome. After splitting from her writer boyfriend, Riccardo, Vittoria meets Piero, a lively stockbroker, on the hectic floor of the Roman stock exchange. Though Vittoria and Piero begin a relationship, it is not one without difficulties, and their commitment to one another is tested during an eclipse.

movie.title: The Ghost
movie.summary: An ex-Interpol officer wreaks havoc and sends shock waves across the global underworld but goes missing in action, only to remerge years later, for his beloved family.

movie.title: Badhaai Do
movie.tagline: Atrangi wedding. Satrangi Setting.
movie.summary: A gay cop and a lesbian teacher enter a sham marriage to pacify their families but find that relationships — both real and fake — aren't all that easy.

movie.title: L'Avventura
movie.tagline: A new adventure in filmmaking...
movie.summary: Claudia and Anna join Anna's lover, Sandro, on a boat trip to a remote volcanic island. When Anna goes missing, a search is launched. In the meantime, Sandro and Claudia become involved in a romance despite Anna's disappearance, though the relationship suffers from guilt and tension.

movie.title: 18 Pages
movie.summary: When a heartbroken Siddhu stumbles upon a two-year-old diary, he finds himself drawn into the enigmatic world of a young woman named Nandini and falls for her.

movie.title: Varisu
movie.tagline: The Boss Returns
movie.summary: Vijay, The prodigal son of business tycoon Rajendran agrees to take over the reins of the business, much to the chagrin of his brothers. But can Vijay prove himself to be a worthy varisu and also reunite his now-broken family?

movie.title: Vadh
movie.tagline: Survival is punishment
movie.summary: Shambhunath Mishra, a retired middle school teacher is living a mundane middle-class life with his wife Manju Mishra in Gwalior. Life takes a complete turn for the Mishra family when a situation gets out of hand and it leads to a killing at the hands of Shambhunath Mishra. Mishra ji has very little time to plan cautiously to turn this into a “perfect murder” and leave no trace behind.

movie.title: Dhamaka
movie.tagline: Double Impact
movie.summary: Swamy and Anand Chakravarthy are lookalikes. Swamy is a jobless guy, while  Anand is the son of Nanda Gopal Chakravarthy, running a company called People Mart. Under dicey circumstances Pranavi, a pretty young girl falls in love with both of them. When JP, a monstrous corporate honcho seeks to acquire People Mart through unethical means, Anand and Swamy’s lives get intertwined.

movie.title: Mission Majnu
movie.summary: Set in the 1970s, an undercover Indian spy takes on a deadly mission to expose a covert nuclear weapons program in the heart of Pakistan.

movie.title: The Conformist
movie.tagline: A dazzling movie.
movie.summary: A weak-willed Italian man becomes a fascist flunky who goes abroad to arrange the assassination of his old teacher, now a political dissident.

movie.title: La Dolce Vita
movie.tagline: The world’s most talked about movie today!
movie.summary: Episodic journey of journalist Marcello who struggles to find his place in the world, torn between the allure of Rome's elite social scene and the stifling domesticity offered by his girlfriend, all the while searching for a way to become a serious writer.

movie.title: HIT: The 2nd Case
movie.summary: Krishna Dev aka KD, a laidback cop working in Andhra Pradesh State HIT, takes on a gruesome murder case. As KD unravels the layers of the crime, the stakes rise unbelievably high and the threat comes unusually close.

movie.title: Au Revoir les Enfants
movie.summary: Au revoir les enfants tells a heartbreaking story of friendship and devastating loss concerning two boys living in Nazi-occupied France. At a provincial Catholic boarding school, the precocious youths enjoy true camaraderie—until a secret is revealed. Based on events from writer-director Malle’s own childhood, the film is a subtle, precisely observed tale of courage, cowardice, and tragic awakening.

movie.title: Le Cercle Rouge
movie.tagline: No place to hide . . . nowhere to run . . .
movie.summary: When French criminal Corey gets released from prison, he resolves to never return. He is quickly pulled back into the underworld, however, after a chance encounter with escaped murderer Vogel. Along with former policeman and current alcoholic Jansen, they plot an intricate jewel heist. All the while, quirky Police Commissioner Mattei, who was the one to lose custody of Vogel, is determined to find him.

movie.title: The Killing
movie.tagline: In all its fury and violence...
movie.summary: Career criminal Johnny Clay recruits a sharpshooter, a crooked police officer, a bartender and a betting teller named George, among others, for one last job before he goes straight and gets married. But when George tells his restless wife about the scheme to steal millions from the racetrack where he works, she hatches a plot of her own.
